subject: rt-int-tr
title: RT.INT.TR.------TRS.
description: Diagram in NYM-19. (C)RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits) is crossed with TRS (transition). Besides the main line to TRS (the crossing), lines run from the subject to LG-DISA (logical dissolution), POST (postulation) and AFTD (affinity tendencies). LG-DISA → CULT-INFO-B (culture information basis). From AFTD branch ACC-FT (accelerated functionalism) → INDIV-DY (individual dynamics), and IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics) → JR-DYM (journalism dynamics) → LK-IMP (linkage implications).
